name: Pendry Chicago
positioning: Luxury boutique hotel in the 1929 Art Deco Carbide & Carbon Building in Chicago's Loop, steps from Michigan Avenue
best_for: Travelers who want a landmark Art Deco base a block or two from Millennium Park and the Riverwalk
Guests traveling with a dog or cat

facts.text: Pendry Chicago is set within the 1929 Art Deco Carbide & Carbon Building.
The hotel is in Chicago's Loop, just steps from Michigan Avenue.
Guestrooms and suites are appointed with an eye for the building's Art Deco heritage combined with a modern vision of luxury hospitality.
Rooms have a black-and-white color scheme, with black-and-white architectural photos on the walls.
Suite types include Studio Suites, One Bedroom Suites, Two Bedroom Suites and Specialty Suites.
The Riverwalk and Millennium Park are both a block or two away.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment and 24/7 guest access.
Venteux is a French brasserie, cafe, and oyster and champagne bar.
Concierges keep in touch with guests by text.
Amenities offered upon availability include house car service, UPPAbaby strollers and the Taylor Academy Guitar Series Program.
The hotel welcomes dogs and cats for an additional fee, a portion of which supports PAWS Chicago.
The Clark/Lake and Washington/Wabash 'L' stations are each about a 10-minute walk away.

highlights.text: The specialty suites are on the 34th to 36th floors, in the neck of the building's bottle shape, where the best views are.
Rooms and suites look out over the city, the Chicago River, Michigan Avenue or Millennium Park, depending on the room.
Château Carbide, the rooftop cocktail bar, has skyline views from the top of the Carbide & Carbon Building.
Pendry Chicago has partnered with AIRE Ancient Baths, about 2 miles away, for priority reservations and complimentary experience enhancements.
Guests can explore the parks on loaner bikes kept at the hotel.

considerations.text: Light sleepers should avoid Michigan Avenue-facing rooms because of noise.
The outdoor rooftop area at Château Carbide is seasonal; its indoor seating is available year-round.
